definitions.explanation: The fleshy part of the body that one sits on.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんのお{尻|しり}を{拭|ふ}く。
{長時間|ちょうじかん}{座|すわ}っていたらお{尻|しり}が{痺|しび}れた。
examples.english: My bottom went numb from sitting for a long time.

notes:
お{尻|しり} is the standard word for buttocks in everyday Japanese.

REGISTER:
The お prefix makes this a polite form. The plain form {尻|しり} exists but sounds rougher. お{尻|しり} is appropriate in most situations.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- お{尻|しり}を{拭|ふ}く: to wipe one's bottom
- お{尻|しり}を{叩|たた}く: to spank
- お{尻|しり}が{痛|いた}い: my bottom hurts
- お{尻|しり}に{火|ひ}がつく: to be in a tight spot (lit. fire on one's rear)

ALTERNATIVES:
- {尻|しり}: plain form (rougher)
- {臀部|でんぶ}: medical/formal term
- ヒップ: hips (often used for shape/fashion contexts)
